name: apps_v_code
sign_convention: vector = mean(H_reflection ∪ H_transition) − mean(H_execution); apply by ADDING coef * vector with coef = -1.0 (SEAL code convention)
boundary_token: any vocab token containing 'ĊĊ' (\n\n), inside <think> only
selection_rule: 500 correct + 500 incorrect, first-in first-fill in file order (--start 0 --sample 500). NO trace is excluded: a generation that never closed </think> stated no answer, so it is a FAILED attempt, filed as INCORRECT and kept -- same rule as v_math / v_code / v_logic.
note: Record recovered on 2026-08-23 from an external dataset repository holding the original 7B APPS build (uploaded 2026-08-09); the vector there is byte-identical to the apps_v_code.pt committed on 2026-08-18. hidden.pt (1.17 GB correct / 2.65 GB incorrect, all layers) is not included here, so pool activation counts are null. The keyword set was not recorded by the original build; 'code' is the set the in-repo recipe uses and is assumed, not verified.
